method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Markets Recoil in Global Sell-Off Driven by Tech Stocks
Equities.reason: Headline encapsulates the dominant market regime shift: a broad, tech-led global equity sell-off that drives risk-off sentiment. High relevance because it signals market-wide leadership rotation and potential spillovers across indices.

Equities.title: Tech rout intensifies as selloff grips global stocks
Equities.summary: Global stocks sold off on Tuesday, led by deep losses for tech stocks following a losing session for the sector on Wall Street.
Equities.reason: Reinforces the primary equity narrative: concentrated losses in large-cap technology/AI names are driving broader market volatility and risk aversion. High relevance due to sector leadership role and amplification of global flows.

Equities.title: Big Tech leads sell-off in global stocks
Equities.summary: Declines on Wall Street reverberate across global markets as SpaceX rally reverses
Equities.reason: FT frames the rout as Big Tech-led with cross-market transmission; important for gauging leadership rotation and investor positioning (leveraged tech exposures). Moderate-high relevance as a confirmatory piece from a major outlet.

Equities.title: Nasdaq futures fall 2% on tech worries, Fed hike bets
Equities.reason: Combines tech leadership weakness with tighter rate expectations — a potent mix for equity risk sentiment. High relevance because it links sector pain to macro (Fed) drivers that affect broad market regime.

Equities.title: South Korea's KOSPI plunges nearly 10% after regulator cautions on leveraged ETFs
Equities.reason: Large, idiosyncratic market event with systemic implications for regional risk and liquidity (forced deleveraging / ETF flows). Very negative for Asian equities and amplifies global volatility; elevated relevance given magnitude.

Equities.title: Korean Stocks Fall More Than 4% From Record High on Tech Selloff
Equities.reason: Highlights Korea as a focal point of the tech-led correction; reinforces the leadership and concentration risk narrative across APAC equities and chip supply chain names.

Equities.title: Stocks Hit by Tech Selloff as Korean Shares Plunge: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Market wrap tying together tech weakness, regional equity crashes and broader risk-off conditions — useful synthesis confirming a cohesive negative market regime.

Equities.title: London shares at over one-week low on rate hike concerns; leadership in focus
Equities.reason: Local equity weakness driven by reflation/rates narrative. Moderately negative — reflects the macro backdrop (rate-hike risk) that broadens pressure beyond tech into cyclical/UK market leadership.

Equities.title: China Stocks in Hong Kong Eye Bear Market on Spending Woes
Equities.reason: China/HK equities under pressure from weak domestic demand — a persistent regional growth problem that supports a negative view for Chinese equities and raises global risk considerations.

Equities.title: Global Funds Snap Indian Stock Selling Streak as Oil Shock Ebbs
Equities.reason: Regional positive — reversal of a selling streak in India as an oil shock eases. Represents localized buying interest and fund flow re-entry; useful nuance against the broader negative global tech narrative.

Equities.title: Equities: Tech-led rotation and volatility in focus – Danske Bank
Equities.summary: Danske Research Team reports that global equities advanced, but underlying performance was highly dispersed, with US consumer and communication services names under pressure while most S&P 500 sectors and small caps gained.
Equities.reason: Research note highlighting dispersion and rotation: supports the view of elevated volatility and sector leadership changes (tech under pressure). Moderately negative as it frames uneven internals despite some breadth.

Rates.title: ECB’s Lane Sees Danger Inflation Will Top 2% for Quite Some Time
Rates.reason: ECB Executive Board member warning that inflation may stay >2% is a hawkish signal for euro-area policy and global rate expectations — pushes yields higher (bond selloff) and is a negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the June 16-17 FOMC meeting
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the June 16-17 FOMC meeting
Rates.reason: Release of FOMC economic projections is a major rates event; projections consistent with a higher-for-longer path increase US rate expectations and weigh on bond prices (negative for rates).

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: The FOMC statement sets near-term policy guidance; in the current market context it reinforced rate persistence, supporting higher US yields and pressuring bond prices.

Rates.title: Stocks hit by Fed rate reality check; oil slips
Rates.reason: Market reaction described as a 'Fed rate reality check' indicates risk repricing and higher US yields driving a risk-off move — confirms bond selloff dynamic (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: SpaceX sheds $400bn in market value as debut rally hits reverse
Rates.summary: Shares in Elon Musk’s AI and rockets group tumble more than 16% following fresh rise in US bond yields
Rates.reason: Equity market reaction explicitly linked to a fresh rise in US bond yields — supports the broader narrative of rising yields and tighter financial conditions (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: Asset Purchase Facility: Gilt Sales – Market Notice 19 June 2026
Rates.summary: This Market Notice sets out the schedule for sales in Q3 2026 of gilts held in the Asset Purchase Facility (APF) for monetary policy purposes.
Rates.reason: Planned gilt sales from the APF increase market supply and represent QT-like pressure on gilts — raises gilt yields and is negative for UK bond prices.

Rates.title: Plan for the Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds
Rates.reason: BOJ public plan for outright JGB purchases is supportive for Japanese government bond prices (caps yields) — a direct, positive interventionary force in the JGB market.

Rates.title: Japan’s 5-Year Bond Sale Demand Weaker Than 12-Month Average
Rates.reason: Weaker-than-average demand at a 5-year JGB sale signals domestic appetite strain and could push JGB yields higher absent BOJ support — a negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Nomura Joins Sony in Powering Big Week for Japanese Bond Sales
Rates.reason: Heavy corporate and sovereign issuance weeks increase supply and can put upward pressure on yields; combined with softer demand this is mildly negative for Japanese bond prices.

FX.title: Euro: Inflation scare questioned as 1.13 level eyed – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale’s Kenneth Broux and colleagues highlight softer Eurozone PMI price data and a dovish tone from European Central Bank (ECB) President Lagarde as key drivers for EUR/USD. They see the 1.13-handle as in focus, with support around 1.1390 and 1.135
FX.reason: FX-native euro piece from a major bank: highlights dovish ECB tone and softer price signals — signals downside pressure on EUR/USD. Medium relevance for intraday EUR narrative.

FX.title: ECB’s Lane: A range of forward-looking signals point to inflationary pressures in coming months
FX.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) Chief Economist Philip Lane said at the European Parliament in Brussels that inflationary pressures in the Eurozone economy could remain above 2% for quite some time despite peace prospects between the United States (US) and Iran.
FX.reason: High-quality ECB commentary suggesting persistent inflation — hawkish tilt for the euro (could be EUR-supportive vs USD). Central-bank forward guidance has above-average FX impact.

FX.title: Euro Hits August Low as Lagarde’s Rates Talk Diverges From Fed
FX.reason: Major-market headline: Lagarde’s dovish messaging diverging from a hawkish Fed is driving EUR weakness vs USD. Bloomberg piece indicates broad market impact — elevated relevance and negative EUR/USD impulse.

FX.title: Eurozone flash Manufacturing PMI rises faster-than-expected to 51.3 in June: What it means for EUR/USD?
FX.summary: Eurozone’s flash Manufacturing Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) arrives at 51.3 in June, higher than 51.2 estimates, but lower than 51.6 in May. The overall business activity has improved significantly, but remained in the contraction phase.
FX.reason: Softly positive economic datapoint for the euro; small supporting signal for EUR/USD but limited by mixed/marginal beat — low relevance to dominant FX flows.

FX.title: The Canadian Dollar hits 14-month lows: Why higher inflation is unlikely to support the Loonie for now
FX.summary: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) is facing renewed pressure as USD/CAD extends its rally to 14-month highs, with Societe Generale noting a decisive shift in momentum and RBC highlighting that domestic inflation remains skewed by volatile energy costs.
FX.reason: FX-native CAD story: USD/CAD at multi-month highs indicates USD strength / CAD weakness. Relevant for USD/CAD flows and commodity-linked currency narrative.

FX.title: British Pound sticks to intraday losses vs bullish USD after downbeat UK PMIs
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair adds to its modest intraday losses and touches a fresh daily low, around the 1.3215-1.3210 region during the first half of the European session.
FX.reason: GBP/USD weakness driven by disappointing UK PMI and continued USD bid — clear FX transmission, medium relevance to sterling-dollar narrative.

FX.title: Fed hike could push yen to 165 per dollar, ex-BOJ policymaker says
FX.reason: Macro interest-rate transmission into FX: expectations of Fed hikes imply further USD/JPY upside (yen weakness). Reuters piece is a clear signal for yen pressure — above-average relevance.

FX.title: Yen Intervention Risk Rises on Reports of Katayama-Bessent Talks
FX.reason: Significant FX-native story: reported talks between Japanese and US officials raise intervention/co-ordination risk. Intervention narrative is highly relevant and supports potential near-term JPY strength or volatility.

FX.title: Japanese Yen edges up from long-term lows amid higher intervention risks
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) is picking up against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday after hitting lows a few pips above the 40-year low of 161.95 on Monday.
FX.reason: Direct FX-market reaction to rising intervention talk — immediate JPY appreciation signal. High relevance because intervention risk alters flow/liquidity dynamics.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Hovers near multi‑decade lows against US Dollar – Deutsche Bank
FX.summary: Deutsche Bank’s Early Morning Reid highlights that the Japanese Yen remains under pressure, trading close to 40‑year lows versus the US Dollar.
FX.reason: Dealer note pointing to persistent yen downside — supports the broader USD/JPY weakness narrative. Useful as a corroborating market-sentiment item.

FX.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Sits near November 2025 top as bulls await move beyond 0.8100
FX.summary: The USD/CHF pair trades with a positive bias for the fifth straight day on Tuesday, near its highest level since November 2025, with bulls awaiting sustained strength above the 0.8100 mark before positioning for further gains.
FX.reason: USD-bullish technical/theme for USD/CHF — implies broader dollar strength (which is negative for non-USD currencies). Relevant to USD-dominant flow narrative.

FX.title: The AI rally has a new test — a rising dollar: Chart of the Day
FX.reason: Macro market-flow piece linking equity themes to a stronger USD; frames dollar strength as a cross-asset headwind — supportive evidence of USD bid and thus negative for other currencies.

Commodities.title: Gold price extends losses into fourth consecutive week: Is the safe-haven bid finally cracking?
Commodities.summary: Gold has fallen for a third consecutive week, dropping to its lowest level since mid-June as a stronger US Dollar and hawkish Federal Reserve expectations erode the metal's appeal.
Commodities.reason: Stronger USD and hawkish Fed expectations directly reduce gold's safe-haven and inflation-hedge appeal — clear negative price impulse for the metal and high-market relevance.

Commodities.title: Deutsche Bank Cuts Gold Forecasts up to 22% as Bulls Temper View
Commodities.reason: Bank-level forecast cuts materially shift gold supply/demand expectations and trader positioning — a notable negative fundamental signal for gold prices.

Commodities.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Tuesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $62.18 per troy ounce, down 4.47% from the $65.09 it cost on Monday.
Commodities.reason: Sharp intraday move lower consistent with metal weakness alongside gold/USD dynamics; direct negative for silver with standard relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil: Gradual recovery and higher risk premium – Societe Generale
Commodities.summary: Societe Generale analysts Michael Haigh and Jeremy Sellem say a tentative United States (US)–Iran truce has eased immediate oil supply fears, driving a sharp fall in Brent and WTI as markets price a restart of Hormuz flows.
Commodities.reason: Easing US–Iran tensions and repricing of Strait of Hormuz flows remove a material geopolitical risk premium, a clear downward impulse for crude with high relevance.

Commodities.title: Brent: Hormuz risk premium fades, forecast steady – OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC’s Christopher Wong notes that easing US–Iran tensions have pushed Brent below USD80 as markets price a high probability of normalised Strait of Hormuz flows.
Commodities.reason: Analyst view that Hormuz risk premium is fading supports lower Brent forecasts — negative for oil prices with above-average relevance given geopolitical context.

Commodities.title: Oil prices fall as investors continue to watch U.S.-Iran moves, Citi sees 'overhang' disappearing
Commodities.summary: Oil falls Tuesday as investors continue to assess the latest developments in the Middle East, while showing optimism the conflict may end soon.
Commodities.reason: Market optimism around a resolution to Middle East tensions is removing a near-term supply overhang, exerting downside pressure on oil — a direct short-term negative.

Commodities.title: Permian natural gas production increased faster than crude oil
Commodities.summary: The Permian region's marketed natural gas production grew from 17.2 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2021 to 27.6 Bcf/d in 2025, a 60% increase, according to data from our latest Short Term Energy Outlook. Over the same period, crude oil production grew b
Commodities.reason: Large, sustained supply growth in the Permian materially increases marketed gas volumes — a strong negative fundamental for US natural gas prices and market balance.

Commodities.title: Solar generation in CAISO surpassed natural gas in the first five months of 2026
Commodities.summary: In the first five months of 2026, utility-scale solar generation surpassed natural gas generation in CAISO. Solar electricity generation in the California Independent System Operator (CAISO) over the first five months of 2026 increased 21% compared with the sa
Commodities.reason: Higher solar penetration lowering natural gas-fired power demand is a negative structural demand signal for regional gas markets (CAISO), moderate relevance to prices.

Crypto.title: Federal Reserve Board requests comment on proposal to require certain payment stablecoin issuers to maintain an effective customer identification program
Crypto.summary: Federal Reserve Board requests comment on proposal to require certain payment stablecoin issuers to maintain an effective customer identification program
Crypto.reason: Regulatory clarity for payment stablecoins (KYC/CIP) is constructive for institutional acceptance and payments use-cases — legitimises stablecoins and on‑ramps despite added compliance costs.

Crypto.title: Bank of England backs down on strict stablecoin holding limits, sets $50 billion issuance cap
Crypto.reason: UK regulator easing/sizing stablecoin rules is a pro-adoption signal that expands issuance capacity — positive for stablecoin market structure and broader crypto flows.

Crypto.title: OKX and NYSE partner to bridge tradfi and crypto markets in joint venture led by Andrew Cuomo
Crypto.reason: Major tradfi-crypto partnership signals accelerated institutional on‑ramp and product development — clear pro-adoption structural story that increases demand and credibility.

Crypto.title: TradFi fund manager Baillie Gifford introduces Solana, Ethereum tokenized fund with BNY
Crypto.reason: Traditional asset manager launching tokenized fund with custody bank is a tangible example of institutional product adoption — supportive for tokenization narrative and flow into majors (ETH, SOL).

Crypto.title: Anchorage aims to bring banks onchain with new tokenized deposit platform
Crypto.reason: Product to tokenise bank deposits targets direct TradFi integration and could drive meaningful institutional flows onchain — structurally positive for crypto ecosystem.

Crypto.title: MoneyGram joins Solana as validator amid stablecoin payment push
Crypto.reason: Payments firm running a validator and pushing stablecoin rails is a real‑world payments adoption signal, supportive for Solana and stablecoin usage.

Crypto.title: Ether’s biggest corporate holders back new Ethereum research hub
Crypto.reason: Corporate backing for Ethereum research strengthens on‑chain development ecosystem and institutional engagement with ETH — net constructive for ETH fundamentals.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETF outflow pain eases just as another headwind gathers strength
Crypto.reason: ETF flow dynamics remain a key driver of BTC price; renewed outflows or growing headwinds weigh on near‑term liquidity and price momentum.

Crypto.title: As bitcoin, altcoin prices gain, derivatives signal skepticism over a sustained rally
Crypto.reason: Derivatives positioning (skew, funding) shows market caution despite price gains — implies limited conviction and raises downside risk for rallies.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin falls under $63,000 as a tech selloff drags risk assets lower
Crypto.reason: Near-term price weakness tied to broader tech/risk‑off moves — relevant to short-term traders but limited structural signal (price/technical focus).

Crypto.title: Bitcoin mining network becoming more sensitive to price swings, JPMorgan says
Crypto.reason: Higher miner sensitivity increases sell pressure and systemic risk during drawdowns — a structural negative for BTC's price stability.

Crypto.title: Securitize and tZERO clash over patents as race to bring Wall Street onchain heats up
Crypto.reason: Patent disputes are a friction but also evidence of an active race to tokenize TradFi assets — overall signal of growing institutionalisation, though legal risks temper the outlook.

Crypto.title: 21Shares co-founder warns tokenization hype is outrunning Wall Street reality
Crypto.reason: Insider caution about tokenization scale tempers enthusiasm — a useful counterpoint reducing conviction in near‑term tokenization-driven flows.
